title: I CERTIFY THAT

certification.text: I CERTIFY THAT: Said applicant has completed 40 hours of driving, of which at least ten hours were after sunset, in compliance with Utah Code Annotated Section 53-3-211 or 53-3-210.5 Utah Code Annotated 1953 as amended.

signatures.label: hereby affirmed ___ day of ___ 20___ Day Month Year

unfillable: ID AFFIDAVIT, DL AFFIDAVIT and ASSUMPTION OF LIABILITY sections (each signed on its own 'X' line)
notes: Legal-size page (612 x 1008 pt). The 40-hour certification is its own 'I CERTIFY THAT' box with an unlabeled 'X' signature line and 'hereby affirmed ... day of ... 20' date line; the oath block is shared with the other sections.
